newsitem.title: FINLAND: Telecom Finland-cellular growth new record in June.
newsitem.headline: Telecom Finland-cellular growth new record in June.

text.p: Finnish state-owned telecom operator Telecom Finland (Tele) said on Friday its cellular subscribers rose 40,587 in June, a record monthly increase.

The increase in digital GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) subscribers was 44,642 but net growth was dented by a fall in analogue NMT (Nordic Mobile Telephone) subscribers, it said in a statement.
The previous monthly record -- a 38,245 increase -- was set last December.
Tele said growth this year had been stronger than last, with the number of subscribers rising to 1.39 million by end-June from 1.21 million at the end of last year.
"In half a year, we have got 180,000 new clients, over 90 percent of which are private," Tele said.
Its total cellular subscriber growth last year was 320,000, a Tele spokesman said.
Tele quoted the Financial Times's Mobile Communications publications as saying mobile penetration in Finland had risen to 33.33 percent; one mobile phone for every three inhabitants.
"The outlook for profitable growth in the future also is good," Tele added.
